Searching app/api/llm, app/api/automation and app/api/sim found zero hits for AGENTS.md, setting-sources, 'instruction file' and cursorrules. The one CLAUDE.md hit is a comment citing the transaction rule (llm-config-race.test.ts:10).

techniques.evidence: app/api/llm/test/route.ts:57 The route spawns Python at the project root. The harness cwd and setting-sources choice is owned by the Python LLM layer, not by this context.
